snippet.title: Five Nights with Maids - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/five-nights-with-maids/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4771580/Five_Nights_with_Maids/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?
